decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already states that Chainlink VRF provides fully on-chain, provably fair winner selection verifiable on Basescan; no correction or additional Event is needed.
The winner-selection technology does not change the manual prize-claim workflow, Winners page announcement, or one-click claim interaction.
Selecting winners through Chainlink VRF does not change which sale types fund the prize pools or how long funding continues.
The Big Block amount, winner count, draw trigger, and eligible population remain unchanged; the shared winner-selection method is independently owned by REQ_PRIZE_WINNER_SELECTION.
The Small Block amount, winner count, draw trigger, and eligible population remain unchanged; the shared winner-selection method is independently owned by REQ_PRIZE_WINNER_SELECTION.
The Chainlink VRF winner-selection decision does not alter the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or primary-mint prize-pool funding.
Winner-selection verification on Basescan does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty or its enforcement.
The prize winner-selection mechanism does not change referral badge thresholds or badge-award conditions.
Using Chainlink VRF for prize draws does not change the asset delivered by a successful mint.
The winner-selection method does not alter use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
Chainlink VRF and Basescan verification for prize selection do not affect the Transak fiat-payment provider, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
The selection provider does not change ticket weighting, independent counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw ticket resets.
